plan.close_all: No open positions to close from prior week.
plan.hostage_policy: Split $2500 notional into up to 4 layers of $625 each. Risk per layer $25 (1% of layer). Use fixed position size equivalent to 0.01 lot adjusted for distance to stop. If aggregate NAV becomes lower than -$100, pause new entries and assess; do not exceed 4 concurrent layers.
plan.rationale: Selected liquid majors near weekly swing lows with positive funding and prior support. Fading short-term weakness with limit entries and tight stops aligns with hostage hunt: collect small premium while keeping risk controlled at 1x leverage.
